title: Civil War Panorama "Battle of Atlanta"
content: Atlanta has restored a significant Civil War cyclorama. It's painted in the round, with sculpted figures in the foreground."It’s a colossal oil painting: 49 feet high, as long as a football field, and conceived as a cyclorama, a wraparound environment for 360-degree viewing...Produced in 1886 in Milwaukee by a commercial outfit called theAmerican Panorama Company, in a workshop staffed by immigrant German and Austrian artists, “The Battle of Atlanta” was one of dozens of cycloramas traveling the country at the time. (Only two survive intact; the other depictsthe Battle of Gettysburg.)"-----Read the rest:New York Times: A Victory for the Civil War ‘Cyclorama’
